outcome: Early postpartum hospital encounter (readmission or ED visit within 3 days after discharge)
cohort: Women who gave birth in California between 2016 and 2018
finding: Genitourinary and wound infections during birth hospitalization were associated with an increased risk of early postpartum hospital encounters, particularly among women who had a cesarean birth.
mod_finding: Cesarean birth combined with major puerperal infection or wound infection was associated with the highest risk of early postpartum hospital encounter.
